description: This file provides utilities for managing network ports, including listing port listeners, force freeing ports, and waiting for ports to become available. It interacts with system tools like 'lsof', 'netstat', and 'fuser' to identify and kill processes occupying specific ports, and includes functions to verify port availability at the OS level.

methods.name: readExecOutput
methods.description: Converts Buffer or string output from execFileSync into a string.

methods.name: withErrnoCode
methods.description: Creates an Error object with an additional 'code' property and optional cause.

methods.name: getErrnoCode
methods.description: Extracts the error code string from an unknown error object.

methods.name: isRecoverableLsofError
methods.description: Determines if an error from lsof or related system calls is recoverable based on error code or message.

methods.name: parseFuserPidList
methods.description: Parses the output of 'fuser' command to extract a list of process IDs.

methods.name: killPortWithFuser
methods.description: Uses 'fuser' to kill processes listening on a specified port with a given signal.

methods.name: isPortBusy
methods.description: Checks if a port is currently in use by attempting to listen exclusively.

methods.name: parseLsofOutput
methods.description: Parses the output of 'lsof' to identify processes listening on a port.

methods.name: listPortListeners
methods.description: Lists processes listening on a specified port, using 'netstat' on Windows or 'lsof' on other platforms.

methods.name: forceFreePort
methods.description: Kills all processes listening on a specified port.

methods.name: killPids
methods.description: Sends a specified signal to a list of process IDs.

methods.name: forceFreePortAndWait
methods.description: Attempts to free a port by killing processes, then waits until the port is free or times out.

methods.name: probePortFree
methods.description: Checks if a port is free at the OS level by attempting to bind a server.

methods.name: waitForPortBindable
methods.description: Polls until a port becomes bindable or a timeout occurs.
